title: Case plugins path: the spec's ../.. loads evals/, not the paqad plugin
context: FR-5 and the plan say every case sets plugins: ["../.."]. The paths are relative to the case dir, and cases sit at evals/<suite>/<case>/, so ../.. is evals/. A real run (scratchpad/noroute/result.json) shows suite.plugins resolved to name 'evals', path <repo>/evals: the paqad plugin was not loaded and the with arm ran without the hook. The probe cases sat one level higher (evals/fw/) so ../.. worked there. The plugin root is ../../.. from a case dir.
